name: TCGplayer
physical_step: sellers ship; marketplace also offers fulfilment and cart optimisation across sellers (per eBay release)
ai_role: price guide and cart optimiser across many card sellers (rules-based; no AI found)
traction: eBay acquired it for up to about USD 295 m (deal announced Aug 2022, closed Oct 2022); 600+ staff
repeat_signal: players buy singles for every new set (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: Europe already has Cardmarket (V3-DE-001); a Polish copy has no gap

name: Reverb
physical_step: sellers ship
ai_role: price guide for used gear (no AI found)
traction: Etsy bought it for USD 275 m (2019) and agreed to sell it for USD 105 m cash (21 Apr 2025)
hype_warnings: resold at about 38% of purchase price (computed from the two figures)
works_in_poland: partly (ships to EU; Polish UI unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: Thomann and Muziker cover new gear in Polish; used gear sits on OLX/Allegro; little room

name: Whatnot
physical_step: sellers ship after live auctions
ai_role: live video auctions; no AI role published
traction: livestream GMV over USD 3 bn in 2024 and USD 8 bn in 2025; valued USD 11.5 bn (Oct 2025) and USD 20 bn (Series G, Aug 2026)
hype_warnings: growth funded by large rounds; category spread beyond collectibles
pl_adaptation_angle: live selling of cards and figures in Polish exists on social media (unverified); capital-heavy to copy

name: BrickLink
physical_step: 10,000+ independent stores ship individual LEGO parts
ai_role: part catalogue by element and colour; Studio design tool builds a parts list from a model (no AI found)
traction: more than 10,000 stores in 70 countries at acquisition by the LEGO Group (Nov 2019)
repeat_signal: builders buy parts for every new model (inference)
take_rate_or_margin: unknown (LEGO said no plans to change fees)
works_in_poland: yes (global marketplace; Polish stores exist, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: no gap: the parts marketplace is global; owned by LEGO

name: Shapeways
physical_step: own print factories (US, NL) printed and shipped parts
traction: filed Chapter 7 on 2 Jul 2024 after defaulting on a USD 669,500 note; assets later bought, brand relaunched
hype_warnings: listed via SPAC 2021, share price fell from USD 83.60 to USD 1.94 (reported); bankruptcy
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard: owning factories for one-off hobby prints did not pay; Craftcloud (V3-DE-005) routes to others instead

name: The Pro's Closet
physical_step: bought used high-end bikes, inspected and refurbished them in own workshop, shipped
ai_role: pricing and sizing tools (no AI found)
traction: raised about USD 90 m; layoffs 2022-2024; announced closure Oct 2024; reopened under new owners
hype_warnings: grew on pandemic bike boom and venture money; holding stock of used bikes
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard: buying and holding used bikes needs capital and staff; marketplace model (buycycle) is lighter

name: Drop (formerly Massdrop)
physical_step: group buys: orders pooled, then made and shipped
traction: Corsair bought certain assets in an all-cash deal, terms undisclosed (17 Jul 2023)
hype_warnings: asset sale rather than growth; later wind-down of the web store reported (unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: group-buy coordination for keyboard parts is a coordination friction; small niche

name: Bulk Reef Supply
physical_step: own warehouse in Minnesota; ships
ai_role: BRStv video content as buying guide; no AI found
traction: revenue estimates conflict: about USD 14 m (ZoomInfo) to USD 50 m (The Ladders); private-equity backed, bought Marine Depot (unverified figures)
repeat_signal: reef keepers buy salt, filters and additives every month (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: content-led shop for marine aquariums; Poland has Aquaforest and many shops (to check in T09)

name: Mystery Tackle Box (Catch Co.)
physical_step: monthly box of lures packed and shipped by the company
ai_role: picks lures by species and region (no AI found)
traction: parent Catch Co. raised a USD 38 m Series B, USD 56 m in total since 2012; revenue grew close to 100% in 2020
pl_adaptation_angle: a Polish fishing box (Fishbox via SubClub, 2014) is not found active; 500,000 PZW members are the pool

name: Cardmarket
physical_step: sellers ship; trustee payment by the platform
ai_role: price trends per card; no AI found
traction: nearly 500,000 users in 30 countries, about 100 m offers, team of 50 (Mar 2021); 5% commission is its only revenue
repeat_signal: players buy singles for each new set (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: no gap for TCG singles; Polish sellers already use it

name: Thomann
physical_step: own warehouse in Treppendorf; ships across Europe
ai_role: reviews and content; no AI found
traction: revenue above EUR 1.26 bn (2021, Bundesanzeiger via Statista); over 18.3 m customers (2024)
repeat_signal: musicians buy strings and accessories repeatedly (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: no gap: Thomann already serves Poland in Polish

name: buycycle
physical_step: sellers ship (platform-arranged shipping, unverified); escrow until delivery (Trustpilot reviews)
traction: 10k+ live listings across bikes, components and gear; Series A raised (company timeline gives 2023; aggregator gives about USD 22 m, Feb 2024: dates conflict)
take_rate_or_margin: seller fee 3.95% plus buyer fee 4% (US terms)
pl_adaptation_angle: escrow plus shipping of whole bikes is the product; Poland trades used bikes on OLX without escrow (inference)

name: bike-components
physical_step: 23,000 m2 warehouse near Aachen; ships across Europe
traction: revenue not published; third-party estimate only (Grips)
repeat_signal: riders buy wear parts (chains, tyres, brake pads) each season (inference)
works_in_poland: partly (ships to PL; Polish UI unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: parts fit by standard (axle, bottom bracket, freehub) is a real friction; German shops already ship to PL

name: Craftcloud (All3DP)
physical_step: partner print bureaus print and ship
ai_role: instant quotes from 150+ providers for an uploaded file (rules-based pricing)
traction: partners with 150+ print service providers (All3DP); welcomed Shapeways users after its collapse
take_rate_or_margin: unknown (says it charges buyers no service fee)
pl_adaptation_angle: Polish print-on-demand is quoted by hand per file (Oferteo, Allegro Lokalnie); an instant multi-bureau quote is the gap

name: WiMo
physical_step: ships radios and antennas across Europe
traction: unknown (site blocks the fetch tool)
pl_adaptation_angle: 16,000 Polish licence holders buy from German shops; small niche

name: Wiggle Chain Reaction Cycles
physical_step: own warehouses; shipped across Europe
traction: entered administration Oct 2023 after parent Signa Sports United withdrew EUR 150 m; Frasers bought brand and IP for under GBP 10 m (Mar 2024); sites later redirected to Evans Cycles
hype_warnings: grew on discounting and pandemic demand; collapse when funding stopped
pl_adaptation_angle: graveyard: price-led bike-parts retail with own stock

name: LoveCrafts
physical_step: ships yarn; patterns sold for designers
traction: total funding about USD 85-102 m (aggregators differ); bought WEBS (US, 2021) and Deramores (2022)
hype_warnings: heavy venture funding for a yarn shop
pl_adaptation_angle: Hobbii (V3-DK-001) shows the profitable version; Polish yarn shops exist (DROPS list)

name: E.H. Thorne (Beehives)
physical_step: makes hives and frames, ships equipment
traction: employs over 100 people, most at Rand, Lincolnshire
repeat_signal: beekeepers buy foundation, frames and treatments every season (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: Poland has Łysoń, a large domestic maker; no import gap

name: Upway
physical_step: refurbishes e-bikes in own hubs; ships
traction: USD 60 m Series C (Nov 2025), over USD 125 m raised, 100,000+ refurbished e-bikes sold, refurbished sales doubled in 2025
hype_warnings: capital-heavy (stock of bikes); profitable only in some markets (company)
pl_adaptation_angle: needs refurbishing hubs and stock: out of reach without capital

name: Philibert
physical_step: own shop and warehouse in Strasbourg; ships internationally
traction: revenue about EUR 24.9 m (2024 12-month year); 100-199 staff (2023)
repeat_signal: gamers buy several games a year (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: Poland has Rebel.pl and many shops; no gap

name: 1001hobbies
physical_step: ships models
traction: unknown (no figure found)
pl_adaptation_angle: model railway gauges and digital control standards are a fit friction; small group in PL (unverified)

name: Catawiki
physical_step: sellers ship; experts curate lots
ai_role: expert curation plus software screening of lots (unverified)
traction: revenue EUR 105 m (2024, later restated EUR 102 m) and EUR 111 m (2025); nearly 3.5 m objects auctioned in 2024
take_rate_or_margin: seller 12.5% plus buyer 9% + EUR 3 (third-party summary, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: no gap: already in Polish

name: Delcampe
physical_step: sellers ship stamps, coins, postcards
traction: more than one million members (company); fees moved to buyers in Mar 2024: EUR 0.30 + 10% per item
hype_warnings: fee shift to buyers (seller retention, inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: no gap for stamps and coins; Polish philatelists are few (6,686 PZF members, 2019)

name: Fishbrain
physical_step: marketplace partners ship gear
ai_role: catch logs and maps predict where and with what to fish (data model; AI role unverified)
traction: over 200,000 paying subscribers and USD 10 m revenue in 2021 with 72% gross margin; about USD 56-74 m raised
hype_warnings: crowdfunding rounds at a high valuation after venture rounds
works_in_poland: partly (app works in PL; Polish UI unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: subscription works because the app finds fish, not because it sells gear; PZW members are the Polish pool

name: Hobbii
physical_step: own brand yarn, ships from Denmark
traction: revenue DKK 621 m and net result DKK 21.6 m (2024); DKK 580 m (2023)
repeat_signal: knitters buy yarn per project; free patterns drive return visits (inference)
hype_warnings: revenue reported down from DKK 831 m in 2022 (aggregator, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: profitable DTC yarn with own brand; would need a Polish shop and own-label supply

name: HobbyLink Japan
physical_step: warehouse in Sano, Tochigi; ships worldwide; no prepayment for preorders
traction: staff of over 70 (2019); also offers wholesale, 3PL and ecommerce services
works_in_poland: partly (ships to PL; customs VAT applies)
pl_adaptation_angle: imports from Japan to PL pay VAT on arrival; a Polish consolidator could batch shipments (inference)

name: Buyee (BEENOS / tenso)
physical_step: buys from Japanese shops and auctions, consolidates and ships abroad
ai_role: translation and search across Japanese marketplaces (unverified)
traction: BEENOS Global Commerce segment GMV JPY 72.5 bn and net sales JPY 12.7 bn in FY Sep 2024 (aggregator, unverified)
pl_adaptation_angle: proxy buying solves Japanese-only shops (Mercari, Yahoo Auctions need a Japanese address/phone)

name: Suruga-ya
physical_step: buys used figures, games, models; grades and resells
traction: revenue JPY 46.1 bn (FY Aug 2025)
pl_adaptation_angle: shows the size of buy-back and resale of hobby goods; needs stock

name: Yushakobo
physical_step: online shop plus Akihabara store; runs the Tokyo Keyboard Expo
traction: first DIY keyboard specialist shop in Japan (Jan 2019); Expo 2026 with 86 companies
pl_adaptation_angle: switch, plate and PCB compatibility is a fit friction; Polish buyers order from abroad (unverified)

name: Bunjang
physical_step: sellers ship; safe-payment escrow; authentication service
traction: revenue KRW 44.9 bn in 2024 (+31.5%), operating loss KRW 19.6 bn; fees 50.4% of revenue; Series E KRW 40 bn (Jul 2024)
repeat_signal: K-pop goods and collectibles trade repeatedly (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: escrow for second-hand hobby goods; Allegro Lokalnie and OLX already offer protected payment (to check)

name: Prusa Research (Printables)
physical_step: makes printers and filament in Prague; ships worldwide
ai_role: Printables model library; no AI found
traction: revenue about CZK 3.7 bn in 2024 (preliminary, Forbes CZ) after CZK 2.9 bn in 2023
repeat_signal: owners buy filament and spare parts repeatedly (inference)
hype_warnings: profit fell to CZK 22 m in 2023 (cc.cz)
pl_adaptation_angle: maker owns the community; spare parts and filament already sold in Polish

name: Muziker
physical_step: own warehouse; ships across CEE
traction: revenue EUR 87.2 m (reported, likely 2025)
pl_adaptation_angle: a CEE player already sells hobby gear in Polish; proof that CEE regional shops work

name: Botland
physical_step: own warehouse in Gola; ships
ai_role: search by Luigi's Box (third-party search engine)
traction: net sales grew 45.69% in 2024 (EMIS; absolute figure not shown); 11-50 staff
pl_adaptation_angle: Polish maker electronics is covered by Botland; no gap

name: Gunfire
physical_step: own warehouse in Wrocław; retail and wholesale across Europe
traction: revenue about USD 9.3 m (aggregator estimate, unverified); 'best airsoft retailer in Europe' 13 years (self-claim)
repeat_signal: players buy BBs, gas and parts every season (inference)
pl_adaptation_angle: a Polish hobby shop that exports across Europe: shows a Polish niche shop can win abroad

name: Rebel.pl
physical_step: publisher, distributor and shop in Gdańsk
traction: annual turnover about PLN 50 m (quoted during the 2020 lockdowns)
pl_adaptation_angle: board games are well covered in Polish; no gap

name: Aquael
physical_step: makes filters, lights and heaters in Suwałki and Warsaw; sells via shops
traction: over 500 staff, two plants (2025 catalogue); sold in 100+ countries (company)
repeat_signal: spare parts and filter media recur (spare-parts catalogue)
pl_adaptation_angle: publishes a spare-parts catalogue by model: a parts-by-model gap may exist for older or foreign filters (to check)

name: BikeExchange
physical_step: bike shops list and ship; bought Kitzuma (US delivery) then scrapped it
traction: CEO resigned and ASX trading halted (May 2022); falling share price; Kitzuma delivery service scrapped
hype_warnings: listed-company losses; added a delivery business then dropped it
pl_adaptation_angle: warning: a multi-shop bike marketplace struggled once shops had their own web stores

name: Scalemates
physical_step: none: shops pay to show price and stock links
ai_role: kit database (550,000 product pages) with prices from 30+ online hobby shops; no AI found
traction: about 550,000 product pages; prices from 30+ online hobby shops (company pages)
repeat_signal: modellers track a personal stash (stash manager)
pl_adaptation_angle: a price-and-stock aggregator for model kits; Polish shops (plastmodel.pl etc.) could be added, see section 6

name: KBDfans
physical_step: ships kits and parts worldwide
traction: unknown (no figure found)
pl_adaptation_angle: keyboard parts come from China and the US; EU stock with fast delivery is the gap (unverified)
